selectedDefinition: For each of the three unordered motif-vertex pairs, retain the exact changed token coordinates and the sign of each nonzero delta, while discarding magnitude; sort the three pair signatures.

findings.statement: DELTA_SIGN_TRIANGLE is the first common passing candidate under the frozen EW-RS-070 order and is scalar-exact on 6x3-k3, 4x5-k4, and 6x3-k4.
Exact signed delta magnitude is not required by the tested scalar map once changed-coordinate identity and exchange sign are retained.

On 4x5-k4, support-only, parity-only, and unsigned absolute-magnitude pair-delta triangles each leave nine scalar contradictions, while the sign triangle is exact. Exchange direction is therefore load-bearing on this carrier.

DELTA_SIGNED_PARITY_TRIANGLE is also scalar-exact on all three hard carriers with ranks 73,282,14, showing further magnitude-related redundancy. It is not the selected rung because the frozen selection order places DELTA_SIGN_TRIANGLE first.

The signed pair-delta carrier is common to mixed-orientation and horizontal-only discovery carriers, strengthening the interpretation that the common law is a support/release exchange relation rather than an H/V/D orientation relation.

whether exact role and depth indices can be structurally compressed inside the signed exchange carrier

nonclaims: DELTA_SIGN_TRIANGLE is not proved globally minimal; it is selected by the frozen EW-RS-070 order.
DELTA_SIGNED_PARITY and DELTA_SIGN are not assumed to form a simple total information ordering.
No individual signed-delta feature or fitted coefficient is promoted as invariant.
EW-RS-059 PRIMARY 3x6-k4 and BACKUP 5x3-k4 remain sealed.
No Q-A/Q-F, standard-7x6, universal theorem, or center-opening proof follows.
next_question: Can the signed pair-delta triangle be compressed outcome-independently by token family, role/depth quotient, or circuit relation while preserving the scalar dependency image?
